story.title: U.S. Revokes Visa of Brazilian Ambassador Amid Diplomatic Tensions
story.summary: The U.S. State Department has revoked the visa of Brazil's ambassador in Washington, escalating diplomatic tensions between the two nations. This decision follows a prolonged period during which the action was delayed to allow Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva an opportunity to de-escalate the situation, which he ultimately did not take.

related_stories.title: Primary Elections Yield Mixed Results for Democrats and Trump-Backed Candidates
related_stories.summary: In the recent primary elections, both progressive and moderate Democrats achieved victories, while Republican candidates endorsed by Trump also showed strength. Notably, William Lawrence, a progressive activist and co-founder of the Sunrise Movement, won the Democratic primary in Michigan's 7th District, positioning him to challenge a vulnerable Republican incumbent in the general election. This election is seen as a critical battleground for control of the House.
